title: Election delay 'a terrible disappointment', Palestinian activist Samer Sinijlawi says
summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Palestinian activist Samer Sinijlawi called the postponement of the first legislative elections in 20 years to September 2027 "a terrible disappointment" for a generation that has never had a chance to vote.
